lavaGeyser.name: Lava Geyser
lavaGeyser.desc: Six tiles light up. Be somewhere else. The whole fight is this reflex.

chainOfSouls.name: Chain of Souls
chainOfSouls.desc: One tile takes a lethal hit split between whoever stands in it. Get everyone there.

voidWell.name: Void Well
voidWell.desc: A tile needs two bodies in it or the raid eats the hit. Learn to commit.

slipgateRift.name: Slipgate Rift
slipgateRift.desc: A dispellable curse that detonates on everyone near you. Cleanse it or clear out.

runeOfBlackMagic.name: Rune of Black Magic
runeOfBlackMagic.desc: An interruptible cast, over and over. Land the Thunderbolt every time.

magmaCleave.name: Magma Cleave
magmaCleave.desc: Hits the tank and anyone beside them, stacking Scorched. Practise not being beside them.
